idea-plugin.name: UUID, ULID & NanoID Toolkit
idea-plugin.description:
UUID, ULID & NanoID Toolkit

Generate and inspect the identifiers you actually use in tests and APIs — no browser, no external tool, fully offline.

  • Generate: UUID v4 (random), v7 (time-ordered), name-based v5 (SHA-1) and v3 (MD5) from a namespace + name, ULID, and NanoID — appended to a list you can select and copy.
  • Inspect: paste any value and see what it is — the UUID version and variant, and the embedded timestamp for UUID v7 and ULID (decoded to a readable instant).

Open it from View ▸ Tool Windows ▸ ID Toolkit.

More Kassi tools for QA & fintech: Kassi Test Data — generate valid IBANs, cards, BIC/SWIFT, VAT and national IDs.

Source, issues & docs: github.com/VadimToptunov/kassi-plugins
